note: Seeded catalogue specialist roles for the synthetic campaign replay; not evidence of running agents.

agents.name: Competitor Supervisor
agents.title: Competitor Scan · Insights
agents.capabilities: Scans competitor offers on the web, checks the catalogue for similar offers and recommends VALUE, MATCH and PREMIUM options; creates the chosen one as a DRAFT.

agents.name: Product Simplifier
agents.title: Insights · Clustering · Data Steward · Simulation
agents.capabilities: Finds duplicate, dead and outlier offers, clusters the catalogue around hero offers and gives migration paths with their impact. Read-only.

agents.name: Catalog Governor
agents.title: Auditor · Read access · Publish handoff
agents.capabilities: Reviews DRAFT offers and audits the live catalogue (completeness, consistency, duplication, compliance); hands PASS offers to release. Read-only.

agents.name: Product Configurator (B2C)
agents.title: Configurator · Technical Enabler · Simulation
agents.capabilities: Turns a plain-language request into a valid consumer plan, validates it against catalogue rules and creates it as a DRAFT.

agents.name: Pricing and Monetisation Strategist
agents.title: Pricing and margin simulation · Insights
agents.capabilities: Models LOW, BASE and HIGH price scenarios with margin, payback and cannibalisation and recommends a price point. Read-only.

agents.name: Marketing
agents.title: Content Generator · Competitor Scan · Insights
agents.capabilities: Writes a launch kit (positioning, headline, SMS, social, banner) from catalogue facts and competitor context, with a compliance check. Read-only.

agents.name: Retainer and Upseller
agents.title: Insights · Churn ML · Content Generator · Simulation
agents.capabilities: Scores churn risk and upsell signals across the customer base and matches each customer to a catalogue offer or add-on. Read-only.

agents.name: Campaign Designer
agents.title: Campaign artwork
agents.capabilities: Builds social, story and banner artwork from reviewed offer facts.
